mechanism: Both drugs prolong QT interval and inhibit cardiac potassium channels; citalopram inhibits CYP3A4/2D6 which metabolizes haloperidol, increasing haloperidol levels and QT prolongation risk.
action: Monitor ECG and QTc interval regularly; consider alternative antipsychotic with lower QT risk or reduce citalopram dose; avoid if baseline QTc >500ms or other QT-prolonging drugs present.
